title: How to Spot a Roots University Student in Islamabad. Tip #1
body: Ask where he studies and wait for the pause before "Roots Ivy," never "Roots University," because the paperwork says university and everyone who actually goes there just says Roots. It's the F-8 campus, and he'll give you the address like that's the whole explanation. Ask what he's doing and it's ACCA, or "a UK degree," meaning University of London affiliation, meaning he never actually left Pakistan for it. He was at Roots since kindergarten, the school did the whole job, this is just the branded exit before a cousin in Manchester sponsors the real one. Ask about the batch and he says "we're basically a family," because there are nine of them in that room and he's known half of them since Montessori.
caption:
Tip #1: kindergarten to "university," never once leaving Roots 😭
